allow: PowerShell(Get-WinEvent -LogName Application -MaxEvents 50 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Level -eq 2 -and $_.TimeCreated -gt \(Get-Date\).AddMinutes\(-30\)} | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Source, @{N='Msg';E={$_.Message.Substring\(0,[Math]::Min\(300,$_.Message.Length\)\)}} | Format-List)
